acceptance.start: accepted only when busy is zero and rst is low
acceptance.busy_start: ignored without changing the active word or timing

timing.start_edge: busy becomes one, sclk remains zero, and mosi becomes data_in[7]; this is not an sclk sampling edge
timing.half_period: while busy, sclk toggles after exactly HALF_PERIOD_CYCLES rising clk edges per half-period
timing.data_sequence: the eight rising sclk edges observe data_in[7] through data_in[0] in order
timing.completion: on the falling sclk edge after the eighth rising edge, busy becomes zero, sclk and mosi become zero, and done becomes one
timing.done: registered one-clk-cycle pulse; zero on all other cycles
timing.quiescent_idle: if a cycle begins with busy=0 and accepts no start, busy, sclk, mosi, and done remain zero; the completion cycle is excluded because done is asserted on that transition

liveness_boundary: Only bounded progress after an accepted start is required; no future start is assumed.
